dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lyney, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! I never imagined I'd run into you here... Seems I owe that gust just now an apology, ha!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: It blew my hat away, seemingly for no reason — but no sooner had I caught it than I ran into you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Planning a visit to the Institute, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Yeah... There's a researcher I'm looking for, one who's also interested in magic. He said he'd like to talk shop with me.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Word is that he's invented all kinds of fantastic devices that are perfect for some truly amazing tricks!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: For example, he once made a miniature thermos that he kept stuffed up his sleeve.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: All he had to do was twitch his finger to activate the mechanism, and voila! The ice within would slide down and out through his sleeve! The "Ice Trick" — one of his myriad magic tricks.

choices.text: Does... that really count as magic?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Hahaha! Of course it counts! Just think about it. You're a poor office worker, sweltering behind your desk. You want nothing more than to head out and buy an ice-cold Fonta to quench your thirst.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: But it's just way too hot. The Fonta machine's broken, and only dispenses warm Fonta. And there's no ice anywhere in the office...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Just as you totter on the edge of despair, the colleague besides you claps their hands, and a few ice cubes suddenly appear in your cup of Fonta... Just imagine. How would you feel?

choices.text: I'd drink the iced Fonta first!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Hahaha, now you get it! That's what he researches: "Close-Up Magic for Daily Use."

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: That's why I'm paying him a visit, too. I'd love to help him refine his close-quarters tricks and improve the impact of his "Close-Up" performances.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: After all, the most important part of magic is the performance, especially when you're up close and personal. Perform well, and the audience will be spellbound...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: They'll think, "I need to get closer! No, no, closer... I must see what surprises this magician's got in store for me..."

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Here. This is for you — to commemorate our meeting today.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'd say you're actually the greatest magician, Lyney...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Hahaha, thanks for playing along. You truly are the best audience I could ask for.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: As long as you're beside me, I know even the thorny tricks will go off without a hitch.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Uh-oh! Would you look at the time! I'd better not keep our man waiting... See you next time!

choices.text: Ah! My Savior, the Archon of Ice Cubes!
Feels more like cheap sleight of hand...
